Name: Sagrada Família (International Mass)
Tips: Sunday Aug 30, 09:00 - the best liturgy in Barcelona, and it starts exactly when the Girona train would leave. DECIDE MASS BEFORE PICKING THE DAY'S OPTION. The clean solve is the Saturday 20:00 vigil, which frees all of Sunday.

Name: Temple del Sagrat Cor (Tibidabo)
Cost Range: Church free; small fee for the tower lift
Tips: MORNING - the church crowning the city, lift up the tower to the Sacred Heart statue, and the widest view of all. Retro hilltop funfair alongside. Go the integrated-fare way: FGC S1/S2 to Peu del Funicular, Vallvidrera funicular (covered by T-casual), then bus 111 to the summit (also covered) - ~0 EUR transport.

Name: Funicular de Vallvidrera
Tips: The integrated-fare leg up toward Tibidabo. Bus 111 continues to the summit, also covered.

Name: Sarrià village core
Tips: ~13:00 - lunch down in Sarrià's village core, then head toward Pedralbes. NOTE: La Boqueria, La Cova Fumada, Quimet & Quimet and El Xampanyet are all CLOSED Sundays - do not route a food stop through La Rambla today.

Name: Monestir de Pedralbes
Tips: 15:00 - a pristine 14th-c Gothic monastery: three-storey cloister, nuns' cells, herb garden. Quiet and green. Municipal museums are free every Sunday from 15:00, which is why this option runs in the afternoon.

Name: Montjuïc Castle
Tips: ~17:15 - ramparts for the harbour panorama. Funicular up from Paral·lel is ON THE T-CASUAL. WATCH OUT: the Montjuïc cable car (telefèric, 13 EUR) is NEVER covered, only the funicular is. MNAC is free Saturdays and first Sundays, NOT today, and needs online booking even when free.

Name: Tablao de Carmen
Address: Poble Espanyol, Av. de Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia 13, 08038 Barcelona
Tips: OPTIONAL - we are already on Montjuïc for the castle at 17:15, and the ticket includes Poble Espanyol entry. Nothing booked.

Name: Last beach hour
Address: Platja de Sant Sebastià / Barceloneta, Barcelona
Tips: EVENING - a last beach hour below Montjuïc's far side, or Barceloneta again, before dinner.

Name: 7 Portes
Tips: ~21:00 farewell dinner (booked either way) - paella institution since 1836. Then pack: tomorrow leaves at 09:40.

Name: Sitges
Tips: LIGHTER 3RD ALTERNATIVE to the whole day - whitewashed beach town with the seafront church on the breakwater, best water near Barcelona. R2 Sud from Passeig de Gràcia, ~40 min.
